title: What a new Ship gets (ship-fleet defaults --json, version 1)
description: Printed on stdout by `ship-fleet defaults --json` on the FleetLedger computer: what `ship-fleet new` uses for each option it is not given, from ships.toml [defaults] and that computer's time zone. Read from ships.toml, the checkout's catalogue and the computer's time zone only: it asks no Ship. The choices themselves are `tools ls --json` and `image ls --json`. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

image.description: Without --image: the pinned image (defaults.image), or stock.

size.description: Without --cores, --memory-mb, --disk-gb: defaults.size, each left out there FleetLedger's own (4, 8192, 40).

mode.description: Claude Code's default permission mode without --mode: defaults.claude.default_mode, else the Ship's own (auto).

allow_bypass.description: bypassPermissions is allowed without --allow-bypass (defaults.claude.allow_bypass, or a default mode of bypassPermissions).

tools.description: The tools it gets without --tools and --no-default-tools: --tools adds to these, --no-default-tools starts from none.

tools_from.description: Where those come from: ships.toml defaults.tools, or the catalogue's defaults (tools ls --json's default).

timezone.description: Without --timezone: the FleetLedger computer's own (TZ, /etc/localtime, /etc/timezone, else UTC), an IANA name.
